self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: When opponents are nearby: DMG Bonus +20% (R1). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: This longbow's color is unpredictable. Under the light, it takes on a lustrous, watery blue.

fr.flavor: La couleur de cet arc long est imprévisible. Sous la lumière, il prend un bleu lustré et aqueux.
